visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a large crowd gathered outdoors on a grassy area, many holding up smartphones to record a stage. A massive gold curtain is suspended from a tall metal truss frame, hiding whatever is behind it. In the background, a building with an ornate green and gold dome is visible among lush green pine trees under a cloudy sky. (2) As a countdown concludes, dozens of purple balloons are released into the air, and the gold curtain drops to the ground, revealing a large bronze-colored statue of a woman reclining gracefully on a crescent moon. (3) A man wearing a black sweatshirt and brown trousers stands on a small stage to the side, holding a microphone and a script. Behind him is a large vertical poster featuring a smiling woman with long reddish hair. (4) The camera pans across numerous colorful flower bouquets—roses, lilies, and carnations—arranged at the base of the statue, with small white cards attached to them. (5) Close-up shots of the statue show the intricate details of the woman's smiling face and the flowing fabric of her dress as she sits on the moon decorated with cutout stars. (6) A large group of fans, mostly dressed in dark clothing, pose together for a commemorative photo, holding large pink inflatable balloons that spell out 'C-O-C-O' and clutching small white gift boxes. (7) A man in a brown winter jacket holds large pink 'C' and 'O' balloons while smiling at the camera, followed by shots of hands waving toward the new monument in a gesture of farewell and love.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with a loud, enthusiastic crowd countdown in Mandarin '3, 2, 1', immediately followed by a burst of loud cheering and applause. A sentimental, high-fidelity pop ballad starts playing with a melodic piano intro and lush orchestral strings. (2) A female vocalist's smooth, resonant voice begins to sing a sentimental song in Mandarin; the audio is a clear studio recording played over the public address system at the event. (3) A male voice with a warm, steady, and narrative tone begins to speak, his speech rhythmically following the music. He speaks with clarity and professional poise, reflecting on memories. (4) The ambient background is clean, with the primary sounds being the amplified speech and music, occasionally punctuated by the distant sounds of the crowd reacting. (5) In the final segment, the crowd transitions into singing 'Happy Birthday' in English, their voices unified and high in emotional arousal, accompanied by the pop ballad's instrumental track. (6) The video concludes with the host shouting celebratory phrases and the sound of continued cheering as the music swells then fades.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the commemorative event of unveiling a memorial statue for the late singer CoCo Lee on her birthday. The video aims to honor her legacy, provide a space for fans to express their grief and love, and convey a message of hope and eternal memory through shared songs and reflection.
